record.summary: Long-running autonomy against a metered resource. Quota exhaustion is detected from the session driver's classification (primary) and observed ~/.claude activity (corroborating); the run parks with a countdown to the parsed or estimated reset, resumes automatically at the next spec boundary, and never probes by burning a session. The daemon itself consumes no model quota.
record.title: Quota scheduler: detect exhaustion, park, resume at the spec boundary
